OpenDuckFrame 0.1.3

  • 优化本地 SDR 视频的 RIFE 插帧：复用相邻原帧输入与特征，减少重复色彩转换和计算。
  • 原始帧优先交付；性能不足时保留原视频播放节奏，减少等待造成的延迟。
  • 完善跳转、会话失效和失败回退后的缓存重建与回归检查。

M5 Max、1080p 24 FPS、RIFE 4.25 fast X2 的单次原生播放核心对照中，有效呈现中位数由约 24.1 提升到 48.1 FPS，任务中位耗时减少约 38%。效果取决于设备与片源；M1 Pro 真机尚未验证。

本版本为社区版，使用临时代码签名及签名验证的应用内更新，未经过 Apple 公证。需要 macOS 14 或更高版本及 Apple 芯片。

English

Improves local SDR RIFE interpolation by reusing adjacent source inputs and cached features. Originals are delivered before waiting for synthesis, with bounded waits when the model cannot keep up. Includes regression checks for seeks, cancelled sessions and stream failure recovery.

A single M5 Max native playback-core comparison with 1080p 24 FPS input and RIFE 4.25 fast X2 measured about 24.1 to 48.1 effective presented FPS and a 38% reduction in median job time. Results vary by hardware and media; M1 Pro hardware has not been validated. This community build is ad-hoc signed, supports signed in-app updates, and is not Apple notarized.

OpenDuckFrame 0.1.2

Fixes a local-video playback stall when frame generation cannot keep up.

  • Original frames no longer wait indefinitely for the model.
  • Missed interpolation deadlines keep the original picture; late results are discarded.
  • Engine failures remain visible, and old results do not enter a newly selected video.

Slow-model timing and file-playback regression checks passed. This release does not guarantee X2 output on slower hardware; M1 Pro physical-display and audio/video synchronization acceptance are still pending.

修复本地视频开启插帧后，慢模型阻塞原片播放的问题。补帧赶不上时保留原画， 迟到结果会被丢弃；真实引擎错误仍会报告。已完成限速模拟与相关回归， 不代表算力不足时仍能达到所选倍率，M1 Pro 真机屏幕与音画同步尚未验收。

This community build uses an ad-hoc code signature and signed update metadata. It is not Apple notarized.

OpenDuckFrame 0.1.1

New installations and the built-in Default preset now start with the same frame-generation settings in source builds and official downloads:

  • Frame generation enabled, using RIFE 4.25 at fast quality.
  • Experimental RIFE stream cache enabled for live window and display capture.
  • X2 multiplier and window output following the source.
  • Scaling remains off until selected by the user.

Existing saved profiles are retained. Selecting this configuration does not start capture or enhancement automatically. Other engines remain selectable; this release changes defaults and does not claim to fix their existing issues.

新安装与内置“默认”预设统一采用 RIFE 4.25、fast、连续缓存、倍率 X2 和跟随来源。 源码构建与官网下载使用相同默认值。已有保存配置继续保留。

This community build uses an ad-hoc code signature and signed update metadata. It is not Apple notarized.
